notes.title: Ojiv is out of Early Access! Enjoy the full release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512195/e7b8e22acedc3f4df199734879d9b98c2aeea81f.png

3 New Songs

 Alternating Current
 Midnight Echo
 Bottle Cap


3 New Girls

 Echo
 Egatlov
 Tessa


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512195/b029439d4441df13e4663e67df44838c042ffc20.png

New Difficulty Level

Every song now has a new difficulty level called Ultra Fast.
By completing this difficulty, you can earn all girl fragments of the song without completing other difficulties.

Steam Inventory Items
You can now collect every girl as a Steam inventory item. Play the game to earn them as drops or visit the item store to purchase them. The collectable items are listed below.


 Emerald
 Ozgesu
 Ecemsu
 Voltage
 Echo
 Egatlov
 Kaida
 Tessa
 Freja
 Smyrna
 Vortex


Accessibility

 You can now toggle the in game moving background. We've received some feedback about the moving backgrounds making the game way too difficult for some people and decided to add a toggle for them. You can find it in the settings.
 Visibility of notes is increased.


New achievements
With the addition of 8 new achievements, there are a total of 24 achievements you can earn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512195/382e2630f957e8300cc9fad0f6b26d3aae772187.png

Bug fixes
Implemented numerous bug fixes. Please let us know in the Steam Discussions forum if you encounter any other bugs.
